indexObservation.sourceTitle: How much do hostels cost around the world? Hostel Price Index for 2023 - Price of Travel
indexObservation.evidenceText: The Price of Travel methodology states that the Hostel Index price is per night, including taxes and fees, for one person in a shared dorm room, averaged over a Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023. The Prague row (country label Czechia) names PLUS Prague and lists $13.77.
indexObservation.referencePeriod: Average Thursday and Friday night in mid-April 2023; Hostel Index 2023
indexObservation.searchQuery: site:priceoftravel.com/how-much-do-hostels-cost-around-the-world Prague Czech Republic Hostel Index dorm bed price
indexObservation.reason: Exact Prague row and explicit index methodology satisfy the one-person shared-dorm, nightly, tax-included contract.
